kaikki_vikisozluk.t: Borrowed from Persian کشمیر (kašmir), possibly through Urdu کشمیر (kaśmīr).
g: Kashmir (a contested geographic region of South Asia in the northern part of the Indian subcontinent, located between (and de facto divided between) India, Pakistan and China)
